compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LMV331IDBVR assigns 1IN+ (IN_POS) whereas TLV7011DBVR assigns OUT (OUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VEE pin (GND vs VEE).
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: LMV331IDBVR assigns 1IN- (IN_NEG) whereas TLV7011DBVR assigns IN+ (IN_POS) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: LMV331IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) whereas TLV7011DBVR assigns IN- (IN_NEG) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VCC pin (VCC+ vs VCC).

Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Soldering TLV7011DBVR onto a LMV331IDBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL OUTPUT STAGE DIFFERENCE: LMV331IDBVR (open-collector) vs TLV7011DBVR (push-pull): the open-collector/open-drain output can only sink current and requires an external pull-up resistor to reach logic-high, whereas the push-pull output actively drives both rails (a pull-up tied to a different rail can back-drive a push-pull stage).

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV331IDBVR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=Non-RR vs TLV7011DBVR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 5.2x (LMV331IDBVR: 26 µA/ch p.6 vs TLV7011DBVR: 5 µA/ch p.7); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 37% higher on TLV7011DBVR (LMV331IDBVR: 224 °C/W p.4 vs TLV7011DBVR: 306.3 °C/W p.6); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LMV331IDBVR requires Vs,min >= 2.7 V (p.4) vs 1.6 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: LMV331IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV7011DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Signal-chain deltas: propagation delay 300 ns (p.6) vs 310 ns (p.7), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.4) vs 5.5 V (p.5), Vos 7 mV (p.6) vs 8 mV (p.7), Ib 1x gap (5 vs 5 pA). Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMV331IDBVR "Reversed U-Pinout SOT-23-5 (Pin 1 = IN+, Pin 4 = OUT) — Incompatible With TLV3201 & TLV7011" (p.3) and TLV7011DBVR "Push-Pull Output Cannot Be Wired-AND or Pulled Up to a Higher Logic Rail" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose LMV331IDBVR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-5 (DBV) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose TLV7011DBVR when single-supply ADC headroom demands full Rail-to-Rail I/O swing or ultra-low supply current (5 µA/ch) is prioritized. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
